name: Loading
description: Shows that work is in progress: a spinner or three dots, inline with a label or as an overlay over the region that is loading. It waits a moment before showing, so fast loads don't flash.

props.name: variant
props.description: The indicator: a spinning ring or three pulsing dots. Emitted as data-variant.

props.name: size
props.description: The indicator's size. Emitted as data-size.

props.name: color
props.description: Tints the indicator. Emitted as data-color.

props.name: label
props.description: What's loading, for screen readers: rendered visually hidden when there's no visible text. The default slot (children) shows visible text instead. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __( 'Loading' ).
props.a11y: The status region's text, so it's announced.

props.name: overlay
props.description: Covers the nearest positioned ancestor on the glass surface, centered. Emitted as data-overlay. Set aria-busy on the region it covers.

props.name: delay
props.description: Milliseconds to wait before showing, so fast loads don't flash. Written inline as --apui-_delay; the root stays in the markup (and the live region in place) meanwhile.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { indicator: '…', label: '…' }.

parts.name: indicator
parts.description: The spinner ring, or the dots (three spans). Hidden from assistive technology.

parts.name: label
parts.description: Visible text from the default slot, or the label, visually hidden.

slots.name: label
slots.description: Visible text beside the indicator, such as Saving changes…; the default slot.

requirements: role=status with a text label (visible, or visually hidden "Loading", translatable); the indicator is aria-hidden.
An overlay leaves aria-busy=true to the region it covers.
The spinner slows and the dots stop under reduced motion.
The indicator keeps 3:1 against its surface in forced colors.
